Our test list groups parked cars and random encounters spotted during our playthrough of GTA 6.

Maibatsu ’97 Penumbra FF (Paul Walker’s Eclipse)

Take the causeway through the Rialto Islands west of Vice Beach.

On Vespucci Island the bright green tribute car is inside a villa garage just north of the road.

Break the side door, switch off the alarm panel on the wall, then open the main garage door.

Maibatsu Penumbra

A plain Penumbra is parked in the multistorey parking structure in Little Cuba most afternoons.

Pegassi Vitello

Villa garage on Flamingo Parkway, east of Belville.

Grotti Itali RSX

Residential garage in the Rialto Islands, two doors from the canal.

You need the key cloner to start it, and it carries an advanced tracker that alerts the police.
